title: Beans and Greens Quesadillas
style: Southern/Tex-Mex mash-up with garlicky collard greens, pinto beans, and melted cheese
description: Crispy tortillas filled with garlicky collard greens, pinto beans, and melted cheese. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

items.item: apple cider vinegar or lemon juice

items.note: cooked or canned, drained and rinsed

steps: Prepare the collard greens: remove the center ribs, stack, roll, and thinly slice into ribbons. Chop lightly if needed.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat. Add collard greens and pinch of salt. Cook 4–6 minutes, stirring often, until wilted and slightly charred.
Add garlic, red pepper flakes, and black pepper. Stir 1 minute until fragrant. Mix in vinegar and remove from heat. Transfer to a bowl to cool.

To make quesadillas: Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. Warm 1 tortilla for 30 seconds per side. Sprinkle half with 30 g shredded cheese, 60 g cooked collard greens, 60 g pinto beans, then another 30 g cheese. Fold over.
Brush top with 0.25 tbsp olive oil. Flip carefully and cook 1–2 minutes until golden. Brush other side and cook until crispy. Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Slice each quesadilla into 3 pieces. Serve immediately with salsa, guacamole, or sour cream/cashew cream. Store leftovers in fridge up to 4 days and reheat gently.
tips: Omit cheese and use cashew cream for a vegan/dairy-free option.
For extra flavor, lightly char the collard greens before assembling the quesadillas.
